title: Field boundaries for Switzerland
description:
The cropfields of Switzerland (Nutzungsflächen) are published per administrative subdivision called Canton.

Each Canton can use a different license. We carefully selected the Cantons that publish the data as open data.

Included Cantons: AG, AI, BE, BL, BS, FR, GE, GL, JU, LU, SH, SO, SZ, TG, UR, VS, ZG
Excluded Cantons: AR, NW, OW, VD, LI
